# Content: Measured failure (ultimate) uniform loads of 19 full-scale three-span continuous lapped Z- and C-purlin roof assemblies tested under uplift (air pressure) with the tension flange through-fastened to steel panels and the compression flange laterally unbraced
# Data basis: measured: failure loads from the pressure-chamber uplift tests (Exhibit B)
column2: member dimensions/yield/initial sweep measured on the failed members; test-to-predicted ratios computed in Exhibits D and E

column1: # Units: see column headers
# Column definitions:
#   test_id = test designation as printed in the report
#   load_direction = direction of applied load on the roof assembly (uplift or gravity)
#   section_type = purlin cross-section type as printed (Zee or Cee)
#   depth_in = nominal purlin web depth
#   thickness_in = measured base-metal thickness of the failed member
#   span_ft = end-bay span length
#   n_spans = number of continuous spans in the test assembly
#   n_purlin_lines = number of parallel purlin lines in the test assembly
#   panel_type = roof panel/attachment system used
#   bracing = lateral/torsional bracing condition of the purlins
#   failure_load_as_printed = failure (ultimate) uniform load per purlin exactly as printed
#   failure_load_unit = unit of the failure load exactly as printed
#   failure_moment_as_printed = failure moment as printed (not reported)
#   failure_moment_unit = unit of the failure moment as printed (not reported)
#   failure_mode = observed mode or limiting condition that ended the test
#   value_source = where in the report the load value is stated
#   pages = PDF page number(s) where the load value is stated
#   flange_width_in = nominal flange width of the purlin
#   total_lap_ft = total lap length
#   fy_ksi = measured yield stress of the failed member
#   initial_sweep_in = measured initial sweep of the failed member
#   failed_member = purlin line/span designation of the member that failed
#   ratio_test_over_aisi6 = ratio of test failure load to load predicted by modification AISI-6 of the 5/1/86 draft Section C3.1.3
#   ratio_test_over_mbma = ratio of test failure load to load predicted by the proposed MBMA formula (R = 0.70 Zees
# EXTRACTION QUALITY: clean — values copied exactly as extracted from the PDF text
# VALIDATION: 15 cells checked (AI
# TEXT SOURCE: read from page images by the model (cached transcription)

# ANOMALY FLAG: Exhibit B footnote: "*Test #12 not taken to purlin failure.  Panels failed at 135 lb./ft. and test had to be aborted.  Purlins appeared close to failure."  Test #10 (original run) is not listed in Exhibit B because the panel failed by tearing at the screws before the purlin failed; no load is printed for it.
# Load direction: all tests are uplift (suction) on the purlins; load applied as air pressure in the test chamber
column2: except Ceco tests 4 and 5 which were run under suction with the test assembly turned upside-down.

column1: # Load on the member was calculated as chamber pressure (manometer reading x 10.4) times a tributary width of 5.06 ft minus the dead weight of the assembly
column2: i.e. the tabulated loads are net of dead load.

column1: # All tests had two lines of purlins (flanges opposed) on three continuous spans; spans shown are end-bay spans. Tests 1-6C
column3: 11 and 12 had three equal spans; the other tests had an end bay 1'-0" less than the interior bay (24 ft end / 25 ft interior).

column1: # Initial sweep sign convention: positive in the direction of the bottom flange lip
column2: negative in the direction of the web.

column1: # Panels were 26 or 24 gauge galvanized panels with 1 1/4 in. ribs at 12 in. o.c. attached with 12 x 14 self-drilling screws at 12 in. o.c. (through-fastened). Tests 10R and 11 used a double thickness of 26 gauge panels.
# Top flanges were torsionally restrained at each support by a wide-flange shape attached to the panels (not attached directly to the purlins).

# Failure mode text from narrative p.5: all failures occurred in an end bay member at or near the point of maximum positive moment; all except Ceco Test #4 were by yielding at the web/compression flange juncture with buckling of the web and compression flange; Ceco Test #4 failed by local buckling of the flange and lip.
# Failed-member designations (A/B purlin line
column2: span number) are from the list on p.6; ratio columns are from Exhibit D (AISI-6) and Exhibit E (MBMA proposal).
